Her finger shook as she selected the number eight in the keypad. Watching the image come up, she held her breath, unsure if she could actually go through with it.

No point in dithering she told herself as she watched an image of her come to the screen. Several seconds later, Kristen wiggled onto the screen making sure to stay at a perfect distance not to wanton or to appear shy.

"Hi I'm-"

"Kristen I know." Mira said calling her by the name on the sign-in page. "I'm not beating around the bush today. Let's talk money and be clear on what I have in mind. On that count, I'd ask that you are the one who flirts and not to try to touch the key board while I'm talking, okay?"

"Um, what I mean is I'd like to know how much do I try to beg for your cash?"

"No one has to beg for money. However, I'm a taker so bear that in mind. I have multiple things in mind so let's pursue those for a time. The first one: I want you to undress down to your main clothes so no shorts or anything like that. I know how expensive professional grade clothing has become and what a costly way for you to make a living as a stripper. I also expect you to think of yourself as an English madam and try to project and perceive yourself that way. No dancing in high heels or manipulative behavior. No trying to beg and plead because of some sob story you think interests me. The bottom line however is keep stripping until I close the session. You think you've got that much spirit in you do you?

Smiling smugly Kirsty though for a second then realized that Mira wasn't going to pad out her time with unimportant things that were said or use stalling tactics which was important. After all, Kristen promptly replied, "Yes, one at a time like this. Except I have no idea of what to guess you like."
